classification.difficultyReason: Compare each rectangle's longer-to-shorter side ratio with A, allowing for rotation and different measurement units between figures. All required dimensions are supplied, and each within-figure ratio uses consistent units.

spec.description: Unshaded horizontal rectangle A with a vertical double-headed height arrow on the left and a horizontal double-headed width arrow below.
spec.mathematics: Rectangle A has height 4 cm and width 6 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: All labels and dimensions are permanent student-visible givens.

children.prompt: Which of these rectangles are similar to rectangle A?

spec.description: Four unshaded rectangles B, C, D and E in a single left-to-right comparison row. C is upright; the other rectangles are horizontal. Every rectangle has its letter inside, a vertical double-headed dimension arrow to its left and a horizontal double-headed dimension arrow below. Drawing sizes are illustrative; printed dimensions define the givens.
spec.mathematics: B: height 12 cm, width 18 cm. C: height 18 mm, width 12 mm. D: height 12 mm, width 18 mm. E: height 60 cm, width 90 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Option labels and all dimensions are permanent givens; no selection or answer marks are shown.

answer.worked:
All corresponding angles are $90^\circ$. Comparing longer side to shorter side:
$$\begin{aligned}A:\quad \frac{6}{4}&=\frac{3}{2}\\B:\quad \frac{18}{12}&=\frac{3}{2}\\C:\quad \frac{18}{12}&=\frac{3}{2}\\D:\quad \frac{18}{12}&=\frac{3}{2}\\E:\quad \frac{90}{60}&=\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}$$
The corresponding sides are proportional, including for C after rotation. Therefore B, C, D and E are similar to A.
